response.instructions:
You are one member of an independent model-judge panel auditing whether a
benchmark evaluator can be reconstructed from public artifacts.

Use only the evidence packet supplied in this request. Do not use prior
knowledge, browse, infer repository behavior that is not shown, or guess from
the benchmark identity. You cannot see other judges, execution outcomes, or
paper conclusions.

Apply these labels literally:
- documented-and-verifiable: stated and independently confirmable in shown evidence.
- partially-documented: consequential information is present but a bounded,
  non-trivial gap remains.
- claimed-but-not-verifiable: an official claim is shown but its referenced
  artifact or implementation cannot be confirmed in the packet.
- not-documented: neither a statement nor implementation is present in the
  inspected packet. Cite the most relevant inspected source(s).
- not-applicable: the criterion genuinely does not apply to this task.
- access-blocked: a referenced artifact exists but requires credentials,
  login, payment, or another access gate.

Code all six criteria. Every decision must cite at least one packet source and
valid inclusive line range. Prefer the more conservative label when evidence
is incomplete. Keep each evidence note factual and under 60 words. Return only
the requested JSON object. Do not assign an overall R2 or quality score.

However, the overall DSBench evaluation harness and data_analysis evaluators are only referenced, not included here.","confidence":"high"},{"criterion":"Grading rules & tie-breaking","label":"not-documented","evidence_refs":[{"source_id":"E002","line_start":7,"line_end":11},{"source_id":"E002","line_start":26,"line_end":29},{"source_id":"E003","line_start":19,"line_end":25},{"source_id":"E004","line_start":19,"line_end":25},{"source_id":"E001","line_start":46,"line_end":54}],"evidence_note":"Scripts compute a raw metric and write it to `result.txt`, but there is no description of how ties are broken, how invalid submissions are handled, or other grading rules beyond the basic metric computation.","confidence":"high"},{"criterion":"Predictions->aggregate-score mapping","label":"partially-documented","evidence_refs":[{"source_id":"E002","line_start":23,"line_end":29},{"source_id":"E003","line_start":19,"line_end":25},{"source_id":"E004","line_start":19,"line_end":25}],"evidence_note":"Each evaluator maps prediction/answer CSVs to a single metric value and saves it, but there is no documentation on how per-task scores are combined into an overall DSBench score across tasks.","confidence":"high"},{"criterion":"Sample predictions / trajectories","label":"not-documented","evidence_refs":[{"source_id":"E001","line_start":36,"line_end":45},{"source_id":"E002","line_start":23,"line_end":25},{"source_id":"E003","line_start":19,"line_end":21},{"source_id":"E004","line_start":19,"line_end":21}],"evidence_note":"The evaluators expect prediction CSVs, but no example prediction files, submission formats beyond column name defaults, or agent trajectory examples are provided in the shown artifacts.","confidence":"high"}]}
